regression: Unmodified v0.11 datasets and base learner. Hybrid3 and product, selection on, all 21 task/stage combinations. Hybrid3 selection-off diagnostic on unary/xor2/and2 first permutation. D512/2048 and two seeds, exact once. Compare archived base fingerprints and baseline outcomes.
new_evaluation: Twelve new partitions of the same structured dependency families, hybrid3 selection on. One- and two-field deletions. Two paired unseen-interaction worlds with identical teachers/selection/calibration but different truth only outside observed combinations. These diagnose limits, not additional supervision.
witness: Training-only unique selected-key/label pairs; class-specific sum of full-key product phase codes. Exact control stores the same binary counts. No key table or oracle in SS inference. Threshold 0.5 is fixed engineering policy, not a probability or calibration guarantee.
completion: Veto-only: original accepted answer must survive every candidate's full selected-key completion over training vocabulary. All complete-key predictions must agree and have unique matching witness. No new labels or answers can be introduced. Sum of branch counts above 256 abstains without accepting a truncated subset.
calibration: Original v0.11 complete clean calibration only. No partial-input labels or final truth used to tune gates, vocabulary, weights or thresholds.

stress.scope: Standalone learned support memory, separate from language accuracy. Known/unknown keys, cross-label hits, finite-phase false support. Exact once per load.

acceptance: No method must win. Check split independence, prior-version equality, accounting, veto-only subset, exact-support lookup consistency, full enumeration budget, zero witness, save/load/isolation, two final runs and archive extraction.
scope: Structured context sufficiency guard, not a new Japanese parser, numeric-only decoder, P1/S1 integration or safety proof for hidden dependencies. All policies keep eligible_for_inference=false. Costs of supplemental class-by-dimension witness arrays and explicit completion enumeration reported separately.
